strings.seo.why[1].text: Mbindi tii maari: kaaniki ta, i dosiyeeji gaa, a baaruuti.
strings.seo.why[2].title: I dosiyeeji siri i ta
strings.seo.why[2].text: A baaruuti, ka taguuti fota. Muna i dosiyeeji wala i baara sabu taari.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Foorama bee
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, images, EPUB… kompyuta wala telefoni ra.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Awa. Gari bee tii kaani kura, taabari tii, mbindi tii maari. Card tii tii seeri.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Tii. Mbindi tii, email tii: gari baara a waati kelen ra.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Tii. I dosiyeeji siri baara i taji waati kelen ra, ka taguuti. Kelen tii a kaari wala a tii dabu.
strings.seo.faq[3].q: A siri baara telefoni ra baa?
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Awa. pdff siri browser bee ra telefoni, tablet wala kompyuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux) ra, sago tii maari.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, images (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML ani gari.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: I siri {files} dosiyeeji baara waati kelen ra, jamabaani {pages} siri ma.
strings.privacy.title: Laabi
strings.privacy.description: pdff siri i dosiyeeji baari waati di: mbindi tii, dosiyee tii siri, pub tii ani data tii taguuti.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff baaruuti ka i dosiyeeji siri i ta. Sira gari ra, a siri baari waati di.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: I dosiyeeji
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: A siri taara encrypted (HTTPS), baaruuti, ka taguuti a waati ra fota. Dosiyeeji boro siri temporary storage ra ka taji tabuuti ani taguuti waati kelen ra; automatic cleanup siri 24 hours ra.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Mbindi tii, personal data tii
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff tii mbindi, email wala card sebi. I dosiyeeji tii kaari, tii seeri wala tii baara artificial intelligence ra.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kira
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Muna kira taji cookies tii (Vercel Web Analytics) ka gari baari taari. Pub tii, tracking tii.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Cookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie kelen: a siri kanni i sebi taari.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Hosting
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Site siri Vercel ra Paris; Word, Excel ani PowerPoint yeeliruuti siri Render ra Frankfurt. Server nne siri baara waati kelen ra.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Sabar
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Hali wala seeri? Taba ni project page ra:
